# Haydn's Homelab

> haydnhomelab.com is the portfolio of Haydn Cowley, an IT student in West Yorkshire, UK, applying for Level 6 cyber security degree apprenticeships starting in 2027. It is not connected to any other Haydn.

Haydn built a Raspberry Pi 5 homelab in a 10 inch rack to learn cyber security, secured it, attacked it himself from Kali Linux and wrote up the results. The website is served from the Pi itself through a Cloudflare Tunnel, so his router has no open ports. Claude (an AI assistant) wrote the code; Haydn built the lab, ran every command and did the testing.

## Owner

- Name: Haydn Cowley
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/haydncowley
- GitHub: https://github.com/haydncow
- Source code and build log: https://github.com/haydncow/haydnhomelab

## What the lab runs

- Pi-hole and Unbound for private, DNSSEC-checked DNS and ad blocking
- Tailscale for remote access, OpenCanary honeypot, UFW firewall, Fail2ban, SSH keys only
- Cloudflare Tunnel with WAF rules and rate limiting, encrypted nightly backups

## Results

- Full Nmap scan: only the 4 ports he opened
- Lynis hardening score 63 to 75
- Security headers F to A+
